## This is a Report: H2 Example

Just a couple of things to start:

-   You have to rename the cover image so there are no characters other than letters in the filename.
    -   So....no file_name.png or file-name.png
    -   Snake Case: ❌
    -   Kebab Case: ❌
    -   Camel Case: ✅

### This is a chart: H3 Example

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4.944
#| out-width: "100%"
small_diamonds <-
  diamonds |>
  slice_sample(n = 500)

ggplot(
  small_diamonds,
  aes(
    x = depth,
    y = price,
    color = cut
  )
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_asn() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::dollar_format()
  )
```

```{=typst}
#blueline()
```
Heads Up: the `#` in `#blueline()` means treat it as a function.

### Here are 2 charts together in the grey box

::: {layout-ncol="2"}
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
ggplot(
  small_diamonds,
  aes(
    x = cut,
    y = price
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::dollar_format()
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
ggplot(
  small_diamonds,
  aes(
    x = color,
    y = price
  )
) +
  geom_violin() +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      color = cut
    ),
    position = position_jitterdodge()
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::dollar_format()
  ) +
  scale_color_asn()
```
:::

# Report Part 2: Tables 

{kableExtra} works really well...

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
iris |>
  head(10) |>
  kableExtra::kable()
```

```{r}
palmerpenguins::penguins |>
  slice_sample(n = 20) |>
  select(1:5) |>
  group_by(species) |>
  arrange(species) |>
  kableExtra::kable()
```

... but {flextable} out of the box? Not so much.  

```{r}
#| fig-align: center
palmerpenguins::penguins |>
  head(10) |>
  select(1:5) |>
  flextable::flextable() |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit")
```

Plain markdown does great...

| Characteristic         | Adult (N=339) | Pediatrics (N=46) |
|------------------------|---------------|-------------------|
| **Educational Status** |               |                   |
| USMG                   | 143 (42%)     | 33 (72%)          |
| IMG                    | 196 (58%)     | 13 (28%)          |


...as does {gt}...

```{r}
palmerpenguins::penguins |>
  head(10) |>
  select(1:5) |>
  gt::gt()
```

...and {gt} ....

```{r}
gtcars |>
  dplyr::select(model, year, hp, trq) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:8) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "model") |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = "numbered",
    rows = matches("^[0-9]")
  ) |>
  row_group_order(groups = c(NA, "numbered")) |>
  tab_options(row_group.default_label = "others")
```

...and some more {gt}.
```{r}
gtcars |>
  dplyr::select(model, year, hp, trq) |>
  dplyr::slice(1:8) |>
  gt(rowname_col = "model") |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = md("**Powerful Cars**"),
    rows = hp < 600,
    id = "powerful"
  ) |>
  tab_row_group(
    label = md("**Super Powerful Cars**"),
    rows = hp >= 600,
    id = "v_powerful"
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = cell_fill(color = "gray85"),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = "powerful")
  ) |>
  tab_style(
    style = list(
      cell_fill(color = "gray95"),
      cell_text(size = "larger")
    ),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = "v_powerful")
  )
```
